The style has a macro that contains a <date>. citeproc-js replaces that <date> by the locale template while it builds the macro (CSL.Util.fixDateNode, via expandMacro from the text builder). The text builder (node_text.rs, wave1-nodes) is still the foundation stub here and never expands macros, so those macros are not built and their dates not replaced. The other 820 trees (parse + the four preprocessing passes) are identical. Expected to be removed at integration.
